issues.explanation: Dashboard uses custom current_entity middleware but it is never registered via Livewire::addPersistentMiddleware, so Livewire update requests would skip tenant resolution.
Tenant and membership authorization is done with inline membershipFor/abort_unless checks instead of going through EntityPolicy via Gate/authorize.
Entity plus owner membership are created directly inside CreateEntity::submit with DB::transaction instead of through an app/Actions class as conventions require for domain writes.
Feature suite is broad but has no unauthorized-call test for CreateEntity::submit as guest and no tamper test for public properties required by the Livewire policy.
EntityFactory makes name unique but derives slug deterministically from it, so two distinct names that slugify identically could still collide.

conventions.evidence: app/Livewire/Entity/CreateEntity.php:148 #[Validate] + validate(); database/migrations/2026_10_29_000000_create_entities_table.php:803 down() present; models use #[Fillable]; docs/database-schema.md:866 updated; but no Livewire::addPersistentMiddleware for current_entity and inline membershipFor checks instead of policies

readability.evidence: app/Models/UserRole.php:11 manageable(); app/Tenancy/TenantContext.php:619 small focused methods; app/Policies/EntityPolicy.php:548 clear predicate names

requirements.evidence: database/migrations/2026_10_29_000000_create_entities_table.php:794 entities_slug_unique; database/migrations/2026_10_29_000001_create_entity_memberships_table.php:834 owner_seq storedAs + entity_memberships_one_owner; app/Livewire/Entity/CreateEntity.php:161 retry loop with uniqueSlug each attempt; app/Livewire/Entity/Dashboard.php:260 403 for non-members; resources/views/entity/switcher.blade.php:973 is-link/data-current=1 vs is-light; lang/en/ui.php:937 and lang/pt_BR/ui.php:951 texts

scope.evidence: change.diff adds only entities, memberships, tenancy, onboarding, dashboard, switcher, routes, langs, docs/database-schema.md:866 and EntityImplementationTest; no members/settings pages, locale middleware, or navbar redesign

security.evidence: app/Livewire/Entity/CreateEntity.php:148 validated name only, Owner hardcoded; app/Http/Controllers/EntityController.php:44 abort_unless membershipFor 403 before session write; views use {{ }}; #[Fillable] mass-assignment set; gap: no addPersistentMiddleware for current_entity on Livewire Dashboard

simplicity.evidence: app/Tenancy/TenantContext.php:619 minimal per-request holder; app/Http/Middleware/CurrentEntity.php:77 direct session dispatch; no service/repository layers or speculative abstractions

tests.evidence: tests/Feature/EntityImplementationTest.php:1139 second-owner rejection, 1255 onboarding create+log+session, 1287 slug-collision retry, 1325 dashboard 403, 1383 pick 403 with session untouched; missing Livewire unauthorized/tamper tests and soft-deleted slug test

review.summary: Implements entities, memberships with single-owner DB guard, policies, tenant middleware, onboarding with slug retry, dashboard, switcher and docs with broad Pest coverage. Overall 4 because requirements/scope/readability are strong but there are small convention, security-persistence and test-completeness nits.
